name: element_tool
description: Designer Tool - Element tool to perform actions like get all elements, get selected element, select element on current active page. and more

siteId.description: The ID of the site. DO NOT ASSUME site id. ALWAYS ask user for site id if not already provided or known. use sites_list tool to fetch all sites and then ask user to select one of them.

label.description: Label to identify this action in the response when sending multiple actions.

component.description: The component id of the element to perform action on.

element.description: The element id of the element to perform action on.

id.description: The id of the element to perform action on, you can find it from id field on element. e.g id:{component:123,element:456}.

name.description: The name of the attribute to add or update.

value.description: The value of the attribute to add or update.

attributes.description: The attributes to add or update.

add_or_update_attribute.description: Add or update an attribute on the element

get_all_elements.description: Get all elements on the current active page

with_resolved_bindings.description: If true, bindings are evaluated to plain strings (or null when unresolvable). If false/omitted, raw values with binding metadata are returned.

name.description: If provided, return only this attribute's value instead of the full list.

index.description: If provided, return only the attribute at this zero-based index. Ignored when `name` is provided.

get_attributes.description: Read attributes from an element. By default returns every attribute as an array of { name, value } pairs. Provide `name` or `index` to read a single attribute's value instead. Set `with_resolved_bindings: true` to evaluate bindings to concrete strings (null for bindings that can't be resolved at design time, e.g. CMS fields); otherwise binding descriptors are returned verbatim.

label.description: A label to identify this query in the results.

setting_key.description: Filter to sources compatible with a specific element setting key (e.g., "altText", "src", "domId").

value_type.description: Filter to sources that produce a specific value type (e.g., "string", "imageAsset").

limit.description: Max results for this query. Default: 50, Max: 200.

get_bindable_sources.description: Get the data sources an element can bind to (props, CMS fields, page fields, locale fields, locale-item fields). Supports multiple labeled queries per call. Both filters are optional — omit them to return all bindable sources for the element. Use setting_key when you know which element setting you want to bind (e.g., altText, src, domId). Use value_type when you only know the data shape (e.g., string, imageAsset).

get_display_name.description: Read the user-facing display name of an element as shown in the Designer's Navigator panel. This is metadata for developer and designer readability — it does not appear in the rendered markup. Returns the custom label string, or null if the element is using its automatic (generated) name. Only valid on elements that expose the DisplayName capability (elements visible in the Navigator — String nodes are excluded).

children_depth.description: The depth of children to include. 0 for no children. -1 for all children. X for X levels deep.

get_selected_element.description: Get selected element on the current active page

type.description: Which SDK call to use: "all_raw_settings" → getSettings() (raw stored values with binding metadata for every setting); "all_resolved_settings" → getResolvedSettings() (bindings resolved to concrete values for every setting); "query_settings" → searchSettings() (full ElementSetting entries with valueType, canBind, display). The queries[] field below is only used when type is "query_settings".

label.description: Identifies this search in the results.

key.description: Filter to a specific setting by key (e.g., "domId", "assetId", "altText").

value_type.description: Filter to settings that produce a specific value type (e.g., "string", "image").

queries.description: Only used when type is "query_settings". Each entry runs a separate searchSettings call and returns its own result block. Pass an empty filter { } to return all settings; omit this field entirely to run a single unfiltered search.

get_settings.description: Read element-level settings (domId, tag, assetId, altText, etc.) in one of three modes. type "all_raw_settings" → getSettings (raw stored values + binding metadata for every setting). type "all_resolved_settings" → getResolvedSettings (evaluated values for every setting). type "query_settings" → searchSettings, with a queries[] array where each entry carries its own { label?, key?, value_type? } filters and runs a separate searchSettings call. Pair with get_bindable_sources to discover what a settable field can bind to.

component.description: The component id of the element to perform action on.

element.description: The element id of the element to perform action on.

prop.description: Optional text prop id. Set when targeting an element inside a TextPropElement or RichTextPropElement of a component instance.

id.description: The id of the element to perform action on. e.g id:{component:123,element:456}, or id:{component:123,element:456,prop:propId} to target an element inside a text prop of a component instance.

component.description: The component id of the anchor element.

element.description: The element id of the anchor element.

prop.description: Optional text prop id. Set when the anchor is an element inside a TextPropElement or RichTextPropElement of a component instance.

anchor_element_id.description: Destination element. For append/prepend it is treated as the parent. For before/after it is treated as a sibling anchor.

creation_position.description: Where to place the moved element relative to anchor_element_id. append/prepend insert as a child of the anchor; before/after insert as a sibling.

move_element.description: Move an existing element to a new location. append/prepend insert as a child of the anchor; before/after insert as a sibling adjacent to the anchor. The element keeps its bindings and styles.

label.description: A label to identify this query in the results.

prop.description: Optional text prop id. Set when targeting an element inside a TextPropElement or RichTextPropElement of a component instance.

element_id.description: Filter by element ID. Exact match. Bypasses other filters — returns the element directly.

type.description: Filter by element type. Exact match. e.g. "Heading", "Image", "Link", "Block", "DOM", "FormForm".

text.description: Filter by text content. Case-insensitive substring match.

style.description: Filter by style/class name. Case-insensitive substring match against any applied style name.

tag.description: Filter by HTML tag. For Block/DOM elements. Case-insensitive exact match. e.g. "section", "nav", "div".

attribute_name.description: Filter by attribute name. Case-insensitive exact match on attribute key.

attribute_value.description: Filter by attribute value. Used with attribute_name. Case-insensitive substring match.

element_filter.description: Filter by element properties. Cannot be combined with component_filter.

component_name.description: Filter by component name. Case-insensitive substring match.

slot_name.description: Filter by slot name. Case-insensitive substring match.

component_filter.description: Filter by component properties. Cannot be combined with element_filter.

prop.description: Optional text prop id. Set when scoping search to descendants of an element inside a TextPropElement or RichTextPropElement.

scope_element_id.description: Scope search to descendants of this element (element itself excluded).

return_parent.description: Instead of returning matched elements, return their parent. "parent" = immediate parent. "ancestor" = any ancestor whose subtree contains matches.

children_depth.description: Include N levels of children in each result. 0 = no children (default), -1 = all.

limit.description: Max results for this query. Default: 50, Max: 200.

query_elements.description: Query elements on the current active page. Supports filtering by type, text, style, tag, attributes, component name, slot name. Supports scoped search, parent lookup, and multiple queries per call.

attribute_names.description: The names of the attributes to remove.

remove_attribute.description: Remove an attribute from the element

remove_element.description: Remove an element from the current active page. DANGEROUS ACTION. USE WITH CAUTION.

select_element.description: Select an element on the current active page

display_name.description: The label to show in the Navigator. Pass '' to reset to the automatic name.

set_display_name.description: Set the user-facing display name of an element shown in the Designer's Navigator panel. This is metadata for developer and designer readability — it does not change the rendered markup. Pass an empty string to reset to the automatic (generated) name. Only valid on elements that expose the DisplayName capability (elements visible in the Navigator — String nodes are excluded).

heading_level.description: The heading level to set on the element. 1 to 6.

set_heading_level.description: Set heading level on the heading element.

static_value.description: The DOM id string. Do not include the leading '#'. Normalized on the host side.

source_type.description: Where the bound value comes from.

binding.description: Bind the DOM id to a data source (component prop, CMS field, page field, locale field, or locale-item field).

set_id.description: Set an element's DOM id (#id). Pass exactly one of static_value (the id string — normalized: invalid characters stripped, spaces → hyphens, lowercased) or binding. Only valid on elements that expose the DomId capability. The stable update_id_attribute action supports only static values; use set_id when you need binding support.

image_asset_id.description: The image asset id to set on the element.

set_image_asset.description: Set image asset on the image element

linkType.description: The type of the link to update.

link.description: The link to set on the element. for page pass page id, for element pass json string of id object. e.g id:{component:123,element:456}. for email pass email address. for phone pass phone number. for file pass asset id. for url pass url.

label.description: Identifies this operation in the results.

key.description: The setting key to write (e.g. "domId", "altText", "href", "visibility", "attributes"). Use get_settings to discover keys.

clear.description: Set true to reset the setting to its default (writes null).

source_type.description: Where the bound value comes from.

binding.description: Bind the setting to a data source (component prop, CMS field, page field, locale field, or locale-item field).

value.description: Static string value. For keys producing string / textContent / id / altText / image (asset ID).

rich_text_inner_text.description: Static rich-text inner content. Maps to { innerText }.

static_text.description: Static text value (string or rich text).

static_number.description: Static number value for numeric settings.

static_boolean.description: Static boolean value for boolean settings (e.g. "visibility").

to.description: Link target. For url/email/phone: literal value. For page: pageId. For file: assetId. For collectionPage: pageSlug. Not used for pageSection — use to_element_id instead.

to_element_id.description: Target element id (component + element) for the pageSection link. Only used when mode is "pageSection".

open_in_new_tab.description: Whether the link opens in a new tab.

email_subject.description: Email subject. Only used when mode is "email".

rel.description: The rel attribute for the link.

items.description: One attribute entry. Exactly one of name_static / name_binding must be set; exactly one of value_static / value_binding must be set.

attributes.description: Only valid when key is "attributes". Replaces the element's full attribute list (pass an empty array to remove all).

items.description: One setting write. Exactly one of clear / binding / static_text / static_number / static_boolean / static_link / static_video / attributes must be provided.

settings.description: The settings to write on this element. Applied atomically in one setSettings() call.

operations.description: The per-element setSettings operations to apply.

set_settings.description: Write one or more element-level settings. Each operation targets one element and batches multiple setting writes into a single atomic setSettings() call. A setting value can be: a static value (via static_text / static_number / static_boolean / static_link / static_video), a binding to a data source (via binding), an attribute list (via attributes, only for key="attributes"), or null (via clear: true) to reset. Use get_settings to discover available setting keys, and get_bindable_sources to discover bindable sources before binding.

style_names.description: The style names to set on the element.

set_style.description: Set style on the element. it will remove all other styles on the element. and set only the styles passed in style_names.

static_value.description: Tag string to set. The valid set depends on element type (see action description).

source_type.description: Where the bound value comes from.

binding.description: Bind the tag to a data source (component prop, CMS field, page field, locale field, or locale-item field). Only supported on DOM and Heading elements.

set_tag.description: Change an element's HTML tag. Pass exactly one of static_value (a tag string — the valid set depends on element type) or binding (DOM and Heading elements only). Valid tag enums by type: Heading → h1|h2|h3|h4|h5|h6; Block / Section / Container / Article / Aside / Header / Footer / Nav / Main / etc. → div|header|footer|nav|main|section|article|aside|...; List → ul|ol; DOM → any string. The SDK rejects invalid tags at runtime.

text.description: The text to set on the element.

static_value.description: true to show the element, false to hide it.

source_type.description: Where the bound value comes from.

binding.description: Bind visibility to a data source (component prop, CMS field, page field, locale field, or locale-item field).

set_visibility.description: Set whether an element is visible on the canvas and in published output. Pass exactly one of static_value (true = visible, false = hidden) or binding (bind visibility to a boolean data source). Only valid on elements that expose the Visibility capability.

new_id.description: The new #id of the element to update the id attribute to.

update_id_attribute.description: Update the #id attribute of the element

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."
